study.question: Can the strongest frozen joint model preserve validation click AUC while reducing measured prediction cost by narrowing prediction towers, task residual bottlenecks, or both, while retaining the history/scorer representation that prior global narrowing damaged?
study.hypothesis: OBSERVATIONS: The byte-identical fresh g2-r0024-joint_capacity_reference reproduced g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached AUC exactly at 0.666753547526167; this is same-seed reproducibility, not independent support. In the preceding full-population 2x2, embedding12 alone achieved 0.6641111848808231 (delta -0.0026423626453438986); scorer-half alone 0.6654368615912554 (delta -0.0013166859349116322); both 0.6657555717414054 (delta -0.0009979757847615733). The exploratory interaction is +0.0029610727954939575. These successful executions are negative quality findings, not execution failures. Both reductions together lowered parameters 32129765 to 24095349, training time 337.0933 to 314.3296 seconds and batch p50 23.4141 to 22.0329 ms, yet whole-validation inference rose 29.0045 to 30.1527 seconds. The single-run timing divergence prevents an end-to-end speed claim. All supplied sources match committed receipt hashes; no previous runtime error is reported. MECHANISM HYPOTHESIS: Global embedding/scorer narrowing may remove useful retrieval information, whereas the downstream nonlinear tower and correction bottleneck may contain marginal capacity that can be removed after the same informative summaries are constructed. Their compensating roles may interact, so use a factorial rather than extrapolate from either alone. Code inspection shows a residual bank evaluated for every task with only the indexed adapter selected; retain that computation unchanged so width is the sole intervention. This is an unverified conventional capacity hypothesis, not a novel architecture claim. AVAILABILITY: This phase supplies model sources, committed validation receipts, archived primary texts and registry tools. It does not supply local torch execution, raw data/checkpoints or an execution/evaluation command. Raw digest/loader re-audits and tensor tests cannot be newly reproduced here; prior host receipts are the starting point. The only authorized present output is a prospective proposal plus standalone model modules; do not install, train, change host contracts or access withheld feedback.

Reference=[128,64]/16; tower-only=[64,32]/16; residual-only=[128,64]/8; both=[64,32]/8. Each module has a literal full CONFIG and matching constructor defaults. No other executable AST change is intended. Both single reductions are component controls for the joint candidate. The original incumbent and historical round24 references remain comparison anchors. Do not infer a parameter-matched allocation mechanism or external-method superiority from this width study. No local training/evaluation CLI is supplied by this phase, so none is invented. A reproducible local syntax-only command is: python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; [compile(ast.parse(pathlib.Path(f).read_text()),f,'exec') for f in ('readout_reference.py','tower_half.py','residual_half.py','candidate.py')]" (run in /workspace; this compiles without executing model code).
predictions: PROSPECTIVE QUALITY RULE, frozen for this batch before host execution: primary validation is_click AUC loss must be <=0.0005 relative to BOTH the fresh reference and original frozen incumbent0.666753547526167 (absolute floor0.666253547526167). This rule is not claimed to have governed the preceding batch. Report every signed difference and logloss even within tolerance. A point estimate passing the screen is preliminary preservation, not statistical equivalence.

PROSPECTIVE COST RULE: a utility candidate must have fewer measured parameters, at least5% lower BOTH model-only batch p50 and p95 latency than the fresh reference at batch8192, and whole-validation inference time <=1.02 times the fresh reference. Training passes remain exactly matched; report training seconds, full trial wall time, allocated GPU cost if exposed, examples processed and peak memory separately. Any slower aggregate inference is disclosed even inside the2% noise guard. Parameter savings alone never pass this cost gate. Timing claims require repeated matched measurements through the host interface.

Analytical parameter predictions, not tensor measurements: the supplied counts imply key_width96, value_width112 and tower input400. Scorer dense27873; four full towers239364; four width16 adapters69312. Expected (dense,total): reference(336549,32129765); tower-half(208677,32001893); residual-half(302117,32095333); both(174245,31967461). Host must confirm feature-map dimensions and counts. Both removes48.2% of dense but only0.505% of total parameters; embedding storage31793216 is unchanged. No storage breakthrough or speed magnitude is promised.

Width8 corrections and/or smaller towers may preserve the frozen summaries predictive value. If only one conditional contrast succeeds, attribute the local observation to that setting. Do not predict interaction sign from the previous embedding/scorer factorial; estimate all four new cells.

All four task AUCs and unweighted logloss must be retained, with auxiliary mean separately from click selection. Report training-defined/existing history bins including empty histories and their sample/positive/negative counts; do not invent unavailable slices or bootstrap outputs. Aux task degradation remains a tradeoff even if click passes.

If a reduced cell passes the screen, freeze its comparison against the fresh full-width model and closest single-factor control before any further assessment. Where the later authorized host interface permits, target three paired seeds and paired user-cluster intervals; require mean delta and the lower95% paired cluster bound to exceed -0.0005 for stronger preservation support. If uncertainty cannot be measured, explicitly retain preliminary status. Repeated seeds are robustness evidence and not independent mechanism contrasts.
falsifiers: Any reduced cell with click AUC below the prospective margin, or without the defined measured prediction-cost reduction, fails this utility screen; do not relax the threshold after observing scores.

Finite-output/backward failure, changed invalid-history dependence, current-action leakage, wrong task shapes, altered Dice buffer ownership or breached auxiliary gradients is an implementation/integrity failure and must be repaired or rejected before scientific interpretation. Charge all attempted host checks and failed runs.

Host tests must establish four finite [B,1] probabilities, correct empty-history gating, invariance to masked item/action/ID perturbations, finite one-step backward, correct auxiliary source/scorer isolation and exactly inherited support-population behavior. Reference source/config must reproduce its known AUC; a discrepancy is investigated before attributing quality changes to width.

If the apparent savings disappear under matched repeated measurements or a quality loss exceeds the tolerance across paired seeds, reject reproducible utility. A full-pass slowdown beyond2% cannot be hidden behind faster kernel latency.

If no reduced cell passes, this bounded readout-width hypothesis has no supported candidate; retain the frozen incumbent and negative records. It does not prove all capacity necessary or refute alternative reallocations.
alternative_explanations: A fixed seed does not match tensor-valued initial weights when tower shapes change; training geometry and implicit regularization are inseparable from this width intervention.
Single-seed validation selection and multiple tested candidates; batch and loading timing noise. The old same-seed byte-identical reference is a reproducibility bridge, not an independent replicate.
Parameter count and dense arithmetic change together. This factorial locates marginal width utility, and does not identify a novel representation or establish a parameter-matched allocation effect.

Dense readout work may be a small fraction of embedding lookup, summary construction, 70-slot scorer and loading cost, so large dense-parameter reductions may produce no meaningful prediction savings.

Observed regularization or optimization changes, rather than redundant representation, may explain preservation or loss. Additional parameter-matched allocation/replacement controls would be needed to claim preferred capacity placement.

Historical auxiliary-label semantics and official_offline visibility are inherited assumptions; these experiments establish only this benchmark. Whole-window vocabularies and publisher snapshots have unestablished production point-in-time validity.
